References and Sources

Every source this website draws on, grouped by publisher and linked to the original.

Home/References

This is the consolidated bibliography behind the site. Each group below is a published collection of documents captured from a recognised regulator, public-health body, professional society or peer-reviewed source. Links open the original.

For the complete, searchable PubMed Central record set for “breast enlargement” (thousands of citations with abstracts), see the PMC research library. For a curated, topic-grouped summary of the studies most relevant to enlargement, see the PubMed research page.

How to use a bibliography

Listing a source here means it forms part of the evidence base for a topic — not that its every claim is endorsed or current. Check the source’s date, its origin and whether it describes your jurisdiction before relying on it.
